name_input: M/S HORIBA INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; HORIBA INDIA PVT. LTD.; HORIBA INDIA PVT LTD; HORIBA INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
product_summary: HORIBA India is the Indian arm of the Japanese HORIBA group. Per the official site (horiba.com/ind), the group/India offering is: (1) Healthcare / in-vitro diagnostics — automated hematology analyzers (Yumizen H550E/H500E, Pentra 80 range, Pentra 60 range, Micros range), ESR analyzers, hemostasis (coagulation) analyzers, clinical chemistry analyzers, immunoassay, veterinary analyzers, CellaVision digital cell morphology systems, HELO automation solution; (2) Energy & Environment — ambient air quality monitors (AP-370/AP-380 series, APNA-380 NOx, APOA-380 ozone, APSA-380 SO2, APMA-380 CO, APHA-380 hydrocarbon, GA-370 trace gas), CEMS/continuous emission monitoring (ENDA-5000/7000 stack gas, CEM400/500, EXM400/500 online gas analyzers), water quality (pH/conductivity/DO/ion-selective electrodes, COD monitor CODA-500, EL200/EL300 controllers, Aqualog); (3) Mobility/automotive test — CVS-ONE, FTX-ONE FTIR exhaust gas analyzers, EXFM-ONE exhaust flow meter, EVCM-ONE, ADS EVO driving system, fuel flow measurement FQ series; (4) Materials/scientific — EMIA carbon/sulfur analyzers, EMGA oxygen/nitrogen/hydrogen analyzers, GD-Profiler glow discharge, XRF, particle size (ANALYSETTE, Eyecon2), Raman/fluorescence spectrometers (FluoroMax, Fluorolog-QM, Duetta, DeltaFlex/DeltaPro), ellipsometers, AFM; (5) Semiconductor — mass flow controllers (CRITERION D700T/D700uF), process gas monitors, CS-1000/CS-900F chemical concentration monitors. Also consumables: ion sensor cartridges, standard solutions, ISA reagents, pH electrodes, calibration gases.
comment: Declared HS 300431 = 'Medicaments containing insulin, put up in measured doses/packings for retail sale'. This is a pharmaceutical finished-drug heading and does not correspond to anything HORIBA sells. HORIBA India is an instrumentation/analytics company (subsidiary of HORIBA Ltd., Japan) — its real lines are measuring, analysing and controlling instruments, not insulin medicaments. Correct mapping: hematology/clinical-chemistry/immunoassay/coagulation analyzers and cell-morphology systems -> 9027.89 (other instruments for physical/chemical analysis) or 9027.50 (instruments using optical radiations) / 9027.10 (gas/smoke analysers) as applicable; blood-cell counters specifically 9027.89; air/gas/emission analyzers -> 9026.20 (pressure/density/flow), 9026.80 (other gas/liquid analysing), 9027.10; water-quality meters (pH, conductivity, DO) -> 9027.80/9027.89; spectrometers/spectrofluorometers -> 9027.30 (spectrometers) / 9027.50; carbon/sulfur/oxygen analyzers -> 9027.89; mass flow controllers -> 9026.20 or 8486.90 depending on semiconductor use; semiconductor process monitors -> 9031.49/9030.89; parts and accessories -> 9027.90 / 9026.90 / 9031.90; ion-selective sensor cartridges and standard solutions/reagents -> 3822.19/3822.90 (diagnostic or laboratory reagents) or 3824.99; calibration gases -> 3824.99/2804.21 etc. Industry classification 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is also a misclassification: HORIBA's dominant segments are healthcare/IVD, automotive test, environmental monitoring, materials analysis and semiconductor — oil & gas/chemical is at most a minor application vertical (process gas analysis). Trader signs: HORIBA India is a sales/service subsidiary of a foreign manufacturer, importing parent-company instruments and reselling them in India, plus distributing third-party brands (e.g. CellaVision, ANALYSETTE/Fritsch, Eyecon2/Innopharmalabs-type OEM) — so manufacturer_trader is the appropriate role. No customs line was available to me in this task (registry/customs research out of scope), therefore the specific HS-6 codes above are the correct classification of the products actually listed on the company's own website and are marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено' as to actual shipment lines. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, declared code 300431 must be corrected to the actual instrument codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected.
